report.summary: Compared to last week: Feeder steers 10.00-15.00 lower.
report.narrative: Compared to last week: Feeder steers 10.00-15.00 lower. Steers weighing 700-750lbs were 15.00 higher on better quality and several buyers had a tight 7 weight order. Feeder heifers steady to 5.00 higher. Today's offering consisted of a large percentage of commodity-type cattle, along with several drafts of weaned steers that looked soft and calf-like in appearance. Steer calves over 500lbs unevenly steady, under 500lbs 10.00-15.00 higher. Heifer calves over 500lbs unevenly steady, under 500lbs 20.00-30.00 higher. Calf quality plain to attractive. Quality played a significant role in buyer participation, with buyers remaining highly selective throughout the sale. Overall calf quality improved as the sale progressed. CME futures closed in the red today.

report.narrative: Compared to last sale: Feeder steer over 600 lbs 5.00-15.00 lower. 800-1,000 lbs steady to 2.00 higher. Feeder heifers over 700 lbs 10.00-20.00 higher. 600-700 lbs 15.00 lower. Steer and heifer calves 5.00-15.00 higher conservatively. Demand strong. Quality ranged from plain to attractive, most of today's calves were unweaned. Several loads of weaned calves unable to make it to the barn as heavy rains have made treacherous road conditions to the ranch.

method: Herd Planner's price model: the hub market (Oklahoma City) plus each barn's own measured difference from it; the range is where 8 in 10 real sales fell when the model was tested on sales it never saw.
